at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:02466e GetStage
at 0 command dynamic:player:0000000000000001 GetDead

local core=require('openmw.core')
local self=require('openmw.self')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local timer=0
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if done then return end
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer<1 then return end
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x38173}}) do
  local actor=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  assert(actor and actor:isValid() and Actor.isDead(actor),'Encounter death missing on reload')
 end
 assert(math.abs(Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current-65.47999572753906)<0.001,'Player health changed')
 local equipped=0
 for _,item in pairs(Actor.getEquipment(self)) do
  if item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x159829) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c1) or item.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x661c3) then equipped=equipped+1 end
 end
 assert(equipped==3,'Club or armor missing')
 done=true print('Substructure defeated encounter restored')
end}}}}
